{{Top|leg}}
The '''Vasuuli relay station''' was a communications center<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/kylekatarnstale|series=Kyle Katarn's Tale|text=Mission 1}}</ref> in the [[Vasuuli system/Legends|Vasuuli system]]<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Vasuuli relay station|system=[[Vasuuli system/Legends|Vasuuli system]]|legends=1}}</ref> operated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Wizards" />

During an [[Battle of AX-456|assault]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] against the nearby [[AX-456]] relay station, a strike team was sent to their rescue, and managed to save some Rebel survivors, including [[Jan Ors]].<ref name="Wizards" />
